title: Wang Desk — a personal AI asset-management firm
subtitle: A four-surface portfolio-manager terminal run by a team of AI agents: analysts, a PM, a risk officer, and a scout — producing daily research on my own capital.
summary: What started as a markets dashboard became a full AI asset-management desk. A team of role-based agents — Analyst, Portfolio Manager, Risk Officer, Idea Scout, Macro Strategist, Distribution Analyst — write dated research memos on every holding, on a schedule, with no human in the loop. The desk runs on institutional-grade data, applies a DCF + comparables valuation engine to every name, back-tests strategies in a lookahead-safe engine, and publishes to a self-hosted terminal I read every morning.

sections.heading: The agent team
sections.body: Seven specialised agent roles cover the investment process end-to-end: per-holding Analyst briefs, weekly PM memos, risk and concentration reports, thematic idea scouting with ranked watchlists, daily macro briefings filtered to the book, ETF/fund shelf evaluations, and a four-persona Investment Committee that debates and votes on each new growth-stock candidate before it enters the ledger. Every memo is dated, filed, and read against kill-criteria written into each thesis.

sections.heading: Institutional data & valuation
sections.body: Market data flows from Yahoo and FRED with a deep-history backfill from WRDS (Wharton Research Data Services) as ground truth on conflicts. A valuation engine computes DCF and comparables-based fair value for every holding. Kill-criteria breaches, position P&L, and thesis drift surface as flags on the cockpit overview.

sections.heading: Strategy Lab
sections.body: A lookahead-safe backtesting engine with walk-forward out-of-sample validation and crisis stress-testing, built to evaluate strategy archetypes on their honest merits — every backtest treated as guilty until proven innocent.

sections.heading: Fully automated operations
sections.body: Daily news and macro briefs generate via CI at market open; the agent team review runs each morning on a scheduler; an idea loop scouts and gates new pitches six times a day. The terminal deploys to a self-hosted server via CI/CD on every push, with a news feed integrated from my separate email-assistant system.

highlights: 7 role-based agent skills producing dated, filed investment memos on a schedule
WRDS institutional data pipeline with cross-source integrity checks
DCF + comps valuation engine over every holding
Lookahead-safe backtester with walk-forward OOS and crisis stress
4-persona AI Investment Committee that votes before a name enters the book
Zero-touch daily operation: CI briefs, scheduled team reviews, auto-deploy
